item.title: Armadale — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Armadale’s story is one of established wealth and careful preservation. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

See our full Armadale suburb guide for the current picture.

What Armadale Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Armadale was always been one of Melbourne’s more well-to-do addresses. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

item.title: Armadale Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets

Is Armadale Expensive?

Armadale is on the pricier side of Melbourne. You’re paying for the location, the prestige, and the quality of the neighbourhood.
